prompt: Create a dark ChatGPT-style image generation result screenshot on a wide 4:3 canvas. The background is solid black, making the subject appear like a transparent-background cutout preview. Place one realistic photographic cutout portrait of Sam Altman in the lower-left to lower-center area: a seated upper-body crop, arms crossed low, wearing a dark navy crewneck sweater, short dark wavy hair, pale skin, neutral thoughtful expression, looking up and to the right, with a small beige headset microphone on his left cheek. Leave a large empty black area on the right and top. Add exactly one rounded brown prompt bubble near the top-right, containing the white lowercase text: transparent background image of sam altman. Add exactly two small UI elements near the bottom: the white word “Edit” at bottom-left and a small white share/upload icon near the lower center-right edge of the cutout. Make the composition look like a clean mobile or desktop ChatGPT image preview screenshot, with no borders, no extra captions, no watermark, and no additional people or objects.

promptZh: 在宽幅 4:3 画布上创建一个深色 ChatGPT 风格的图像生成结果截图。背景为纯黑色，使主体呈现出透明背景抠图预览的效果。在左下至中下区域放置一张 Sam Altman 的逼真摄影抠图肖像：半身坐姿，双臂低位交叉，身穿深蓝色圆领毛衣，留着深色短卷发，肤色白皙，表情中性且深思，看向右上方，左脸颊戴着一个小巧的米色耳麦。在右侧和顶部留出大面积的黑色空白。在右上角附近添加一个圆角棕色提示词气泡，内含白色小写文本：transparent background image of sam altman。在底部附近添加两个小型 UI 元素：左下角的白色“Edit”字样，以及抠图右下边缘附近的一个小型白色分享/上传图标。构图需呈现出简洁的移动端或桌面端 ChatGPT 图像预览截图效果，无边框、无额外标题、无水印，且不包含其他人物或物体。
